items.title: Awesome Nix
items.content_text:
### Command-Line Tools / Discovery

*   [nixos-cli (⭐336)](https://github.com/nix-community/nixos-cli) - Configurable all-in-one CLI for common NixOS tools with an emphasis on improved user experience.
*   [optnix](https://git.sr.ht/~watersucks/optnix) - A terminal-based options searcher for Nix module systems.

### Overlays / Webinterface

*   [neovim-nightly-overlay (⭐387)](https://github.com/nix-community/neovim-nightly-overlay) - Daily bumped Neovim nightly package.

items.title: Awesome Cakephp
items.content_text:
### Miscellaneous

*   [DatabaseBackup plugin (⭐23)](https://github.com/mirko-pagliai/cakephp-database-backup) - A plugin to to export, import and manage database backups. Currently, the plugin supports MySql, Postgres and Sqlite databases.
